definitions.gloss: mom friend; fellow mother; mother acquaintance
definitions.explanation: A friend or acquaintance who is also a mother, typically met through children's activities.

examples.japanese: {保育園|ほいくえん}でママ{友|とも}ができた。
examples.english: I made a mom friend at the nursery school.

examples.japanese: ママ{友|とも}とランチに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to lunch with my mom friends.

examples.japanese: ママ{友|とも}{関係|かんけい}のストレスで{悩|なや}んでいる。
examples.english: I'm stressed out about my relationships with other moms.

notes:
STRUCTURE:
ママ (mama) + {友|とも} (friend)

CONTEXTS WHERE MOM FRIENDS ARE MADE:
・{保育園|ほいくえん} / {幼稚園|ようちえん} (nursery/kindergarten)
・{公園|こうえん} (park)
・{習|なら}い{事|ごと} (children's lessons)
・PTA

RELATED TERMS:
・パパ{友|とも} - dad friend
・ママ{友|とも}グループ - mom friend group
・ママ{友|とも}トラブル - mom friend trouble/drama

CULTURAL NOTE:
ママ{友|とも} relationships are a significant social phenomenon in Japan, often discussed in media for both positive support networks and occasional social pressure or drama.
